item.title: Chris Sluman's leukemia battle continues but he has some expert help
item.description: Chris Sluman's fight against acute lymphoblastic leukemia continues and he's getting support from far and wide including his sister-in-law who is a US-based pediatric oncologist

item.title: Powassan Voodoos did some 'Rock' blasting on Friday night at the Sportsplex
item.description: Dylan Rousselle scored three times and added an assist in the Voodoos impressive home ice win over Timmins

item.title: North Bay Battalion beat the Knights in London in a dramatic win
item.description: In a gutsy effort, the Battalion took it to London, tying it late and winning in a shootout to and a three-game losing streak

item.title: Rising costs push West Nipissing to end hazardous waste deal with North Bay
item.description: Municipality plans to host one-day drop-off, and continues to investigate options for residents

item.title: Voodoos roll over Blind River Beavers 6-1 on Saturday night in Powassan
item.description: Voodoos outscored their opponents this weekend 10-2 and are closing in on clinching a playoff spot

item.title: Powassan Voodoos Pereira is the NOJHL Rookie of the Month with 17 points
item.description: Jax continuing to take it to the max for the Powassan Voodoos as his 17 points in January earned him NOJHL honours for the month's best rookie

item.title: East Ferris seeks nominations for outstanding volunteers through recognition program
item.description: ‘People volunteer across so many different sectors, and they contribute countless hours every year to make East Ferris a better place,’ says Greg Kirton, Director of Community Services

item.title: North Bay Battalion suffer agonizing 2-1 loss versus Niagara IceDogs
item.description: North Bay manages one win in three road games but scored just 6 goals on weekend trip and now are tied with IceDogs for second in Central Division
